row.proto: void Career_Collect_TeamEntriesByKey(void *out, void *src, uint32_t team_key, void *alloc)
row.notes: (out, src, key, alloc) Walks records src+8..src+0x10 with stride 0x88, collects pointers whose u8 +0x58 == key low byte and u16 +0x5a == key>>16 into vector out {alloc, begin, end, cap} (x1.5 growth via alloc vslots +0x18/+0x38). Callers incl. Career_DeptEvent_Start. (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V10210 Collects pointers to records matching u8@+0x58/u16@+0x5a, but the source array stride is 0x88 bytes (not 0x58); 0x58 is the key offset.
